 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Insert color 2 in every one-cell gap between repeated motif cells in a row."""
    if not grid or not grid[0]:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors = [v for v in counts if v != background]
    motif = max(colors, key=lambda v: counts[v])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        positions = [c for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == motif]
        for a, b in zip(positions, positions[1:]):
            if b - a == 2 and row[a + 1] == background:
                out[r][a + 1] = 2
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    test = [
        [6,6,6,6,6,9,6,9,6,9,6,9,6,6,6],
        [6,9,6,9,6,6,6,6,6,6,6,6,6,6,6],
